verdict.rationale: Several product operations take natural-language input: Classify uses natural-language rules, extraction schemas can be generated from a prompt, and parsing output can be steered with custom prompts. A hosted MCP endpoint also exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split and Index as tools, so users can drive these operations in plain language through an MCP-capable agent. However, natural language mostly serves as parameters to API/SDK calls, and operating the product end to end in natural language depends on an external agent client. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command/chat interface for operating the platform, documentation of end-to-end natural-language workflows via the MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.
